ADMITTED_DOCUMENT_RECORDS.definition: Formal admission records confirming municipal provenance and non-quarantine status.

ADMITTED_SOURCE_FILES.definition: Municipal source files passing municipal boundary verification and admitted into active intelligence corpus.

ATOMIC_SEGMENTS.definition: Fine-grained atomic proposition and article segments loaded in memory and indexed across BM25, Exact, and Graph lanes.

CADASTRAL_PARCELS.definition: Verified cadastral parcels mapped to spatial zones and planning regulations.

CANONICAL_KB_FILES.definition: Self-describing canonical KB master files structured under schema hemiksem-kb-v1.1.

DOCUMENT_FAMILIES.definition: Top-level municipal domain families (spatial plans, regulations, finances, environment, governance).

PRIMARY_INDEXED_INSTRUMENTS.definition: Deduplicated municipal planning, spatial (RUP/BPA), regulatory, and administrative instruments directly registered in engine doc_registry.

PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_FAMILIES.definition: Canonical spatial planning and regulatory families with public evidence projections.

PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_PROJECTIONS.definition: Pre-computed public evidence stub projections carrying complete cryptographic and legal provenance for Custom GPT reference.

RAW_SOURCE_FILES.definition: Total physical raw source files preserved in municipal RAG archive (PDFs, spatial decrees, official gazettes, municipal decisions).

RETRIEVAL_FAMILIES.definition: Total active searchable domain families in retrieval engine.

SEARCHABLE_DOCUMENTS.definition: Distinct instruments searchable across all 4 retrieval lanes.

SERVER_LOADED_DOCUMENTS.definition: In-memory document instruments loaded for fast exact retrieval and routing.

SPATIAL_PLANS.definition: Binding spatial plans (RUPs, BPAs, Gewestplan) active in municipality.
